verdict.rationale: Moss, a semantic-search runtime rather than an agent, has a first-party MCP server integration page. It says AI assistants can create indexes, add documents and run sub-10ms semantic queries from within the conversation, and a probe confirmed the official MCP server documentation exists. Missing for 10: setup and configuration details (transport, client config, auth), a full tool list, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works as described.
